_about: Samuel Ward (1577-1640), town preacher of Ipswich: A Collection of such Sermons and Treatises as have beene written and published by Samuel Ward, Bachelor in Divinitie and Preacher of Ipswich, gathered into one volume (London: John Grismond, 1636), including The Life of Faith, The Life of Faith in Death, A Coal from the Altar, Balm from Gilead and Woe to Drunkards. Early English Books Online scans of first or early printings; the OCR prints the long s ('ſ') and old type, so expect errors. Not to be confused with Samuel Ward (1572-1643), Master of Sidney Sussex. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
